wiki.title: John R. McCravy III
wiki.extract: John Robinson McCravy III (born September 6, 1958) is an American attorney and politician. He is a member of the South Carolina House of Representatives from the 13th District, serving since 2016. He is a member of the Republican party and chairman of the Family Caucus within the South Carolina House. In addition to serving in the State House, McCravy is an attorney and teaches law at Lander University. He is the primary sponsor and architect of South Carolina's fetal heartbeat bills.
